name: lem-prh-sharpness-row-coincidence
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-prh-sharpness-row-coincidence — Row coincidence for stochastic idempotents: for every integer n >= 1, every n-by-n row-stochastic idempotent matrix F=(f_ab) over R, and all i,j in {1,...,n}, if f_ii>0 and f_ij>0 then row_i(F)=row_j(F).
